hymns.title: Wa Tsɛ Mawu Nɔ Ko Be Kaa Mo

verses.text:
Wa Tsɛ Mawu, nɔ ko be kaa Mo,ɔx
O peeɔ nyakpɛ ni '
O peeɔ nyakpɛ ni kɛ haa wɔ;
Wa maa je O yi daa kɛ daa,
Wa naa Mo si, wa maa hwe O nɔ gojoo,
Wa Tsɛ Mawu nɔ ko be kaa Mo.

hymns.title: Wa Naa Mo Si, Mawu Tobi

verses.text:
Wa naa Mo si Mawu Tobi
Wa jeɔ O yi Mawu Tobi,
Wa hueɔ O biɛ nɔ, Mawu Tobi,
Mawu Tobi, wa naa Mo si.

Tobi ɔ sa yi jemi,
Tobi ɔ sa si nami;
Nyɛɛ ha wa kɛ sina ha Lɛ DC
Lɛ pɛ nɛ E sa yi jem'.

Ye Mawu hi
E hi ha mi.

Klɔuklɔu, Klɔuklɔu, Klɔuklɔu,
Wa ngɛ Mo gbaa Asafo Yehowa,
Mo ji klɔuklɔu, klɔuklɔu;
Wa naa Mo si Asafo Yehowa,
Mo ji klɔuklɔu, klɔuklɔu
Wa hue O nɔ Asafo Yehowa,
Mo ji klɔuklɔu, klɔuklɔu
Wa jɔɔ Mo daa Asafo Yehowa.
Mo ji klɔuklɔu, klɔuklɔu

E maa nyɛ maa pee,
E maa nyɛ maa pee,
E maa nyɛ maa pee ha wɔ,
E maa nyɛ maa pee.
E pe ha wɔ ta,
E pe ha wɔ ta,
E pe ha wɔ ta Yesu ee,
E pe ha wɔ ta.

hymns.title: Wo O Bua, Koo Ye Gbeye

verses.text:
Wo o bua, koo ye gbeye,
Wo o bua ngɛ Yesu mi.
O Mawu ɔ nɛ o ngɛ Lɛ jae, DC
Lɛ nɛ E maa kpɔ mo.

Nyɔmtsɛ tu munyu,
Kɛ mi pee O nɔ,
Nyɔmtsɛ tu munyu,
Konɛ ma nu.
Nyɔmtsɛ tu munyu
Kɛ mi pee O nɔ
De nɛ ma pee,
De nɛ ma bu tue.
Ablam Mawu
Isaac Mawu
Yakɔb Mawu

hymns.title: Muɔ Ko Ngɛ Bee Ngɛ Kalvali

verses.text:
Muɔ ko ngɛ bee ngɛ Kalvali,
Wami ngɛ jamɛ a muɔ ɔ mi.
Jamɛ a muɔ mi, jamɛ a muɔ mi
Jamɛ a muɔ mi he wami ngɛ.
He wami ngɛ, he wami ngɛ,
He wami ngɛ Yesu muɔ ɔ mi.
Hiɔ tsami ngɛ
Yi wam'hem' ngɛ
Tuem' jɔm' ngɛ.

hymns.title: Yesu, Ta Nɛ Ɔ, O Ta 'i

verses.text:
Yesu, ta nɛ ɔ, O nɔ 'i
Wa be he wami ko,
Juɛmi hu be wa dɛ
Yesu, ta nɛ ɔ, O nɔ 'i

hymns.title: O Mi Mi Jɔmi He Je

verses.text:
O mi mi jɔ mi he je:
E sa nɛ ma na Mo si
Ngɛ blɔ fɛɛ blɔ nɔ;
I ye Mo si nam' hiɔ,
Nɛ I kɛ ba Mo hami.

hymns.title: Je Ɔ Tsuo Mawu, Je Ɔ Tsuo Mawu

verses.text:
Je ɔ tsuo Mawu, je ɔ tsuo Mawu
Ma fɛɛ ma maa je O yi DC
Ma fɛɛ ma maa na Mo si.

hymns.title: Benɛ I Ngɛ Wami Nɛ Ɔ

verses.text:
Benɛ I ngɛ wami nɛ ɔ
Ma je O biɛ ɔ yi daa;
O sa yi jem', O sa sina,
Mo ji klɔuklɔu Mawu,
Ma je O biɛ ɔ yi daa.

Dlolɔ, wa Nyingmo,
Wa kɛ yi jem' ha Mo,
Ngɛ he nɛ O kɛ wɔ ba su nɛ ɔ,
Wa na Mo si daa.

Adesa lee, kai nɔ nɛ Mawu pee ha mo,
Nɛ o ngɔ sina ha Lɛ, nɛ o ngɔ yi jem' ha Lɛ;
O jem' nɛ o ngɛ nɛ ɔ, e ji E dloomi kɛkɛ.
Adesa lee, kai nɔ nɛ Mawu pee ha mo,
Nɛ o ngɔ sina ha Lɛ, nɛ o ngɔ yi jem' ha Lɛ.

Guguetsɛ kpanaa Yehowa,
O he wam' kle, O he wam' kle;
Wa maa jaje O ni tsumi tsuo pɛ,
Ejakaa O ni tsumi kle agbo,
Guguetsɛ kpanaa, Yehowa,
O he wam' kle, O he wam' kle.

hymns.title: Wa He Falɔ Ji Mo Yehowa

verses.text:
Wa he falɔ ji Mo Yehowa,
O mi nɛ he tsɔli tsuo maa na wesa he,
O mi nɛ he tsɔli tsuo maa na he jɔmi,
Wa he falɔ ji Mo Yehowa.

hymns.title: Ye Huɛ Kpakpa Ngɛ Ye Kasam'

verses.text:
E pe ye huɛ kpakpa po',
Ja nɛ Yesu ngɛ,
E ji ye huɛ kpakpa,
Ngɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ mi,
Lɛ ji ye Tɛsa, ye tsɛi kɛ ye wesa he,
E ngɛ ye kasam', ye huɛ kpakpa,
Ja Yesu ngɛ.

hymns.title: O Adebɔ Nihi Ngɛ O Yi Jee

verses.text:
O adebɔ nihi ngɛ O yi jee,
Hiɔwe bɔfo ngɛ Mo jae;
He tsɔli hu ngɛ lae ke,
Jɔɔm' ha O biɛ, jɔɔm' ha O biɛ.

hymns.title: Asafo Yehowa Nɛ Kɛ Wɔ Ngɛ

verses.text:
Asafo Yehowa nɛ kɛ wɔ ngɛ,
Asafo Yehowa nɛ kɛ wɔ ngɛ,
Odeopeɔ, Odeopeɔ, Mo ji Walɔ kpanaa,
Halleluya, Asafo Yehowa nɛ kɛ wɔ ngɛ.

E hueɔ E nine nɔ,
E hueɔ E nine nɔ ngɛ be nɔ,
He wam' tsuɛɛ pɛ baa si,
Nɛ E biɛ Imanuɛl tsɔɔ wɔ kaa
Mawu kɛ wɔ ngɛ mwɔnɛ hu,
Mawu kɛ wɔ ngɛ daa.

(YESU REFRƐ WO)
Lɛ ji nɔ dlalɔ, Lɛ ji hiɔ tsalɔ,
Nɔ nɛ e puɛ ɔ, Lɛ ji e dlalɔ;
Yesu ngɛ mo tsɛe, Yesu ngɛ mo tsɛe,
Nɔ nɛ e puɛ ɔ, Lɛ ji e dlalɔ.

Mawu suɔ E bimɛ,
Nɛ E jeɔ mɛ kɛ jeɔ a haomi mi
Benɛ a gbɔjɔ, benɛ a gbɔjɔ,
Nɛ a hɛ nɔ kami kulaa e ta,
Yehowa maa hyɛ,
Kaa a ma na yiwam' hem' blɔ ko.

hymns.title: Mawu, Mo Pɛ Nɛ Wa Ma Ja

verses.text:
Mawu lee, Mo pɛ nɛ wa ma ja,
Mo nɛ O bɔ hiɔwe kɛ zugba,
O wo mumu kɛ wo adesa mi
Loko adesa ba pee kla hɛ kalɔ,
Wa ma ja Mo daa nɛ ɔ.

hymns.title: Mo Ji Mawu, O Tsake We

verses.text:
Mo ji Mawu, Mo ji Mawu,
Mo ji Mawu, O tsake we
Ke o hue E munyu ɔ, nɛ o kɛ ngɛ o jem' bae,
Ke je mi si him' he wa ha mo,
Nɛ o hɛ nɔ kam' nya ta po
E maa hyɛ, Mawu maa hyɛ, Mawu maa hyɛ,
Nɛ E maa hi ha mo.

Mawu hi, eee Mawu hi daa,
Kaa E ha je na wɔ ekohu,
Nyɛɛ ha wa la kɛ je E yi.
Mawu hi, Ao Mawu hi daa.

Ye Mawu kai mi hu
Kai mi nɛ e hi ha mi,
I be kpɔlɔ ko nɛ ngɛ kaa Mo,
I kpla si ngɛ Mo tsɛe.

Blema Mawu, wa ma ja Mo
Ke wa je O se, nɔ ko nɔ ko be,
Blema Mawu, wa ma ja Mo.

hymns.title: Sina Tsuo Ji O Nɔ, Yesu

verses.text:
Sina tsuo ji O nɔ, Yesu Nyɔmtsɛ,
Ye Tɛsa ngua Mawu:
Yi jem' tsuo ji O nɔ, Yesu Nyɔmtsɛ,
Ye tsɛi kɛ weto he ji Mo pɛ.
Ye Mawu, nɔ nɛ O pee hyɛ fuu,
O dloom' he nɛ wa ngɛ wam';
Sina tsuo ji O nɔ, Yesu Nyɔmtsɛ,
Wa ma de nɔ nɛ O peeɔ ha je ɔ.
Yesu, wa ma tsua O biɛ daa, daa,
Ye tsɛi kɛ wesa he ji Mo pɛ.

hymns.title: Ma Ngɔ Ye Kla Kɛ Ye Tsui

verses.text:
Ma ngɔ ye tsui kɛ ye kla tsuo kɛ je ye Mawu yi
Ma ngɔ ye nɔmlɔ tso hu kulaa kɛ ma na ye
Mawu si,
Ke I hyɛ nɔ nɛ Mawu pee, E ngɔm' kɛ mɔbɔ
nami hu
E sa kaa ma ngɔ ye nɔmlɔ tso kulaa kɛ sa afɔle
ha Yesu,
I kɛ ye lilɛ ma hue E nɔ: ejakaa Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ e
kpɔ mi
Kɛ je abonsiam' dɛm', kɛ e nyɔguɛ mi.

Nyɛ hɛ ka si, nyɛ huɔ, fa kue,
Nɛ nyɛ ko sɛ kami mi;
Ejakaa Abosiam' ngɛ huɛe kaa jata
Ngɛ nyɛ hlae nɛ e puɛ nyɛ;
E kɛ ninyɛ kɛ nya hiɔmi,
Kɛ mi gbami hu ma ba nyɛ mi oo,
Waa ngɔ suɔmi, kake peemi,
Kɛ hem'kɛ yem' tsi lɛ blɔ.

I ye Mo sina hiɔ, I ye Mo sina hiɔ,
I ye Mo sina hiɔ, I ye mo sina hiɔ,
Ye wam' sihi nɛ ɔ m' Mo pɛ ji ye Kpɔlɔ
Ke I nɛ Mo si ɔ, I pe otlumu.

verses.label: Chorus
verses.text:
Mawu lee, ye nɔ yam' ngɛ O dɛm,
Mawu lee, ye ni nam' ngɛ O dɛm',
Mawu lee, ye wami hu ngɛ O dɛm',
Ke I nɛ Mo si ɔ, I pe otlumu.

E ji mi dalɔ ha mi, E ji tulɔ hu ha mi,
Yesu, Yesu, E ji mi dalɔ ha mi.

Nyɛ hue E nɔ, Yesu ji Matsɛ
Nyɛ hue E nɔ Yesu ji Matsɛ
Nyɛ hue E nɔ Yesu ji Matsɛ
E ji Matsɛ nitsɛ
Matsɛmɛ a Matsɛ, e sa kaa wa kpla si ngɛ
E hɛm',
Nyɛ je E yi, nyɛ wo E hɛm' nyami'.

Nakutsohi kulaa nɛ a kpla si ha Mawu,
lilɛhi tsuo pɛ a je Mawu biɛ ɔ yi,
A je E yi, a je Mawu Bi ɔ yi,
A na Lɛ si, a na Mawu Bi ɔ si,
Nɛ a de ke Mawu ji Opemɛ.

O kle gojoo, nɛ O ji agbo,
O kle nɛ O ngɛ gojoo;
Mɛnɔ po nɛ e kɛ Mo maa sɔ?
O kle nɛ O ngɛ gojoo.
Mɛnɔ po nɛ wa kɛ ma to O he?
O kle nɛ O ngɛ gojoo.

hymns.title: Nyɛ Ha Wa Nyɛɛ Wa Mawu Ɔ Se

verses.text:
Nyɛ ha nɛ wa nyɛɛ wa Mawu ɔ E se,
Nyɛ ha nɛ wa ngɔ wa he hu fɔ E nɔ:
Lɛ ji Nɔ nɛ E pa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ko,
E ma pee ha wɔ.

verses.label: Chorus
verses.text:
Oh, E maa pee ha wɔ,
Anyɛmi, E maa pee ha wɔ.

Yehowa katsɛ,
Wa ma je O biɛ nɛ ɔ yi,
O ni tsum' kpakpa he,
Wa ma je O yi.

verses.label: Chorus
verses.text:
Gbenɔ mi, wami ji oo,
Wa ma je O biɛ nɛ ɔ yi:
O ni tsum' kpakpa he,
Wa ma je O yi.

hymns.title: I Na Yesu, Yosɛfu Bi Ɔ

verses.text:
I na Yesu Yosɛf Bi ɔ,
Nɔ nɛ blema tsɛmɛ tu E he munyu ɔ,
Nɔ ko kpakpa ko
Ma nyɛ ma je Nazalɛt hu lo?
Nyɛ ba ba hyɛ, nyɛ ba ba hyɛ,
Yesu nɛ ji wa Kpɔlɔ
Mo ba ba hyɛ.

Wa kɛ si nam' ha Mawu,
Mawu nɛ E kɛ wɔ ngɛ.
E ni tsumihi nɛ E tsu ɔmɛ ngɛ nyakpɛ,
Ni kpakpahi nɛ ji jɔɔmi,
Lɛ tsuo jeɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ dɛ,
Si nam' afɔle nɛ sa, a kɛ ha Lɛ.

verses.label: Chorus
verses.text:
A kɛ ha Lɛ, a kɛ ha Lɛ,
A kɛ ha wa Nyɔmitsɛ,
Nihi kpakpa nɛ ji jɔɔmi,
Lɛ tsuo jeɔ Nyɔmitsɛ ɔ dɛ mi;
Si nam' afɔle nɛ sa, a kɛ ha Lɛ.

hymns.title: Adebɔ Nihi Tsuo A Mawu Ji Mo

verses.text:
Adebɔ nihi tsuo a Mawu ji Mo
Mo pɛ nɛ O sa yi jem'
Mo pɛ nɛ O sa yi jem',
Mo pɛ nɛ O sa si nam',
Adebɔ nihi tsuo a Mawu ji Mo,
Mo pɛ nɛ O sa yi jem'.

hymns.title: I Kɛ Ye Tsui Kulaa Ma Suɔ Mo

verses.text:
I kɛ ye tsui kulaa ma suɔ Mo pɛ,
Mo pɛ ji ye blɔ tsɔɔlɔ,
Ma suɔ Mo, ma suɔ Mo,
Nɛ ma ja Mo nɛ hi.
I kɛ ye tsui kulaa ma suɔ Mo pɛ,
Mo nɛ O ji ye blɔ tsɔɔlɔ.

O haa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ nya ngma,
O haa wɔ hɔ n- kami,
Mawu Kpetekple,
Oklemekuku Mawu

O haa suɔ hu nya mi ngma,
Tatu hu naa ni nɛ e yeɔ,
Mawu Kpetekple,
Oklemekuku Mawu.

Yosa hu naa bi nɛ e fɔɔ,
Gbosi bimɛ naa bua jɔm',
Mawu Kpetekple,
Oklemekuku Mawu.

Wa ngɛ Nyumu kpanaa,
E biɛ ji Yesu;
E he hia mi wawɛɛ,
Ma tsɛ E biɛ ɔ daa nɛ ɔ,
Ma ha jemɛ a je kulaa na Lɛ kaa
Wa ngɛ nyumu kpanaa;
E biɛ ji Yesu,
E he hia mi wawɛɛ.

Mawu, O mi mi jɔ,
O mi mi jɔɔ ha wɔ daa.
Wa jeɔ O yi daa,
Wa hue O biɛ ɔ nɔ,
Wa la alleluya ke
Mawu mi mi jɔ,
O mi mi jɔ ha wɔ daa.

hymns.title: Yehowa, Wa Heɔ O Biɛ Ɔ Ye

verses.text:
Yehowa, wa jeɔ O biɛ ɔ yi,
Wa hue O nɔ gojoo,
Wa woɔ O biɛ ɔ hɛm'nyam',
Aleluya.

verses.label: Chorus
verses.text:
Wa nya si buam' wa kɛ lami,
Ma je O biɛ klɔuklɔu yi,
Kɛ ya si benɛ O maa ba.
Aleluya.

E kɛ wɔ yaa, Yesu E kɛ wɔ baa,
Be tsuaa be ɔ, Mawu ji Matsɛ,
E kɛ wɔ yaa, Yesu E kɛ wɔ baa
Be tsuaa be ɔ Mawu ji Matsɛ
Aleluya, be tsuaa be; hosiana be tsuaa be
Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu be tsuaa be, E kɛ wɔ yaa.

hymns.title: Wa Maa Je O Biɛ Ɔ Yi

verses.text:
Wa maa je O biɛ ɔ nɛ ɔ yi:
O ye kunimi ha wɔ,
Tobi ɔ nɛ a gbe Lɛ,
Esa lɛ kaa a je E yi,
Mawu Tobi , wa ma je O biɛ nɛ ɔ yi.

O biɛ ɔ ji nyakpɛ biɛ, dloomi hyi Mo tɔ,
O biɛ ɔ ji nyakpɛ biɛ, jɔɔmi hu ngɛ mi;
O biɛ ɔ ji nyakpɛ biɛ, dloomi hyi Mo tɔ,
Yesu, O biɛ ji nyakpɛ biɛ.

Gbenɔ nyɛ we Lɛ, E ye gbeje nɔ kunim'
Kunim' yem' Matsɛ ji wa Nyɔmtsɛ,
Wa ha Mo, mo Yesu ee
Ayekoo, Messia,
Kunim' yem' Matsɛ ji wa Nyɔmtsɛ.

hymns.title: Kɛ O Blɔ Wo Yehowa Dɛm'

verses.text:
Kɛ o blɔ wo Yehowa dɛm'
Nɛ o kɛ o hɛ fɔ E nɔ,
Lɛ nɛ E ma nyɛ ma pee ha mo,
Lɛ nɛ E ma nyɛ ma pee ha mo.

hymns.title: Kpale Ba Ngɔ O Yi Jemi

verses.text:
Kpale ba ngɔ O yi jemi,
Hiɔwe kɛ zugba Bɔlɔ
O 'nunyam' kpɛɔ ngɛ hiɔwe,
Kɛ zugba a nɔ.

Mo ji Mawu Matsɛ kpanaa,
Ke o kpasa Lɛ, o hɛ mi be si pue,
Aleluya, Mo ji Mawu Matsɛ kpanaa.

I daa si ngɛ Kalvali yoku ɔ sisi
Nɛ I hyɛ nɔ nɛ Mawu pee;
Nɛ I hyɛ nɔ nɛ Mawu pee
Nɛ I hyɛ nɔ nɛ Mawu pee
I daa si ngɛ Kalvali yoku ɔ sisi,
Nɛ I hyɛ nɔ nɛ Mawu pee.

hymns.title: I Be Nyɛɛ Ma Na Mo Si

verses.text:
I be nyɛɛ ma na Mo si,
Nɔ nɛ O pee kɛ ha mi,
I be nyɛɛ ma na Mo si.
E sa kaa ma na Mo si,
Nɔ nɛ O pee kɛ ha mi,
E sa kaa ma na Mo si.

Abraham, Mawu Tsɛ kpakpa,
Kɛ o he tsuo pɛ ha Lɛ;
He Lɛ o ye, E ma pe ha mo,
Lɛ ji Mawu, Lɛ ji Mawu nɛ hi.

Hiɔwe kɛ zugba Bɔlɔ,
O biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ tsuɔ nyakpɛ ni;
Wa ka Mo hyɛ, nɛ wa na kaa
O sa yi jem', Nyɔmtsɛ, O sa yi jem'.

Bua jɔm' sane agbo,
Nɛ ngɛ kaa kikɛ enɛ ɔ,
Wa mi dalɔ Mawu ngɛ ha wɔ,
Sina kɛ ha Matsɛ hɛ kalɔ,
Nyakpɛ suɔmi nɛ E kɛ suɔ wɔ daa.

verses.label: Chorus
verses.text:
Mawu ngɛ daa o haleluya,
E kɛ E dloomi ɔ hyɛɔ wa nɔ daa nɛ,
E haa wɔ daa nya ngma,
E peeɔ wa hiami nihi tsuo,
Haleluya, Mawu ngɛ daa nɛ.

Tsɔɔ wɔ blɔ, o blɔ tsɔɔlɔ Mawu,
Nyɛ wa hɛm' nɛ O tsɔɔ wɔ blɔ.
O munyu ɔ, O munyu ɔ,
O munyu ɔ, e ji la;
O munyu ɔ, O munyu ɔ,
O munyu ɔ haa wami.

Fo kɛ pue E nɔ, nɛ E ma kpɔ mo,
E ji Mawu nɛ E mi mi saa Lɛ,
Fo kɛ pue E nɔ, nɛ E ma kpɔ mo.

Mo de Lɛ koo E maa pee ha mo
E ji Mawu nɛ E mi mi saa Lɛ
Fo kɛ pue E nɔ, nɛ E ma kpɔ mo.

Ke I pa ye nya nɛ I ngɛ sɔle,
Ye Tsɛ ngɛ hiɔwe le nɔ nɛ hia mi.

I le kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ma bli blɔ ko ha mi
Ke I ba ye je mi kpakpa nɛ he tsɔ,
Kpa yayam' peem' nɛ ma pee kpakpa,
I le kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ma bli blɔ ko ha mi.
I le kaa Mawu ma bli blɔ ko ha mi
I le kaa Mawu ma bli blɔ ko ha mi
Keji I nyɛɛ ngɛ hiɔwe la a nya,
Kpa yayam' peemi, nɛ ma pee kpakpa

E ji Mawu kpetekple nyakpɛ no
'nɔkuale Mawu;
E kpa E kɔnim' kɛ E ta hwum' nihi tsuo
Ngɛ he nyɛli a nɔ.
E piɛ ye he, I yi nɔ ko gbeye,
Mawu kpetekple, wa jeɔ O yi daa nɛ ɔ.

Adebɔ nihi tsuo, nyɛ kpla si ha Nyɔmtsɛ:
E ye kunim', anunyam' sa Lɛ,
Matsɛ Yesu ji wa Nyɔmtsɛ.

hymns.title: Nyɛ Ha Wa Ya Hyɛ Lɛ
Yesu, Yesu, E Ngɛ Ha Wɔ Daa

verses.text:
Yesu, Yesu, E ngɛ ha wɔ daa,
Yesu, Yesu, E ngɛ ha wɔ daa;
E ji hiɛ Yesu,
E ji mwɔnɛ ɔ Yesu,
E ji huɔ hu Yesu,
E ngɛ ha wɔ daa.

Fi si, ko ye gbeye,
Fi si ngɛ Yesu mi,
O Mawu ɔ nɛ o ngɛ Lɛ jae ɔ, Lɛ nɛ
E ma kpɔ mo.

hymns.title: He Wam' Tsuo Pɛ Ngɛ O Dɛ

verses.text:
He wami tsuo pɛ e ngɛ O dɛ,
Mo nɛ O bɔ hiɔwe kɛ zugba,
Ao, he wami tsuo pɛ ngɛ O d0.
Yehowa hi nɛ E suɔmi ngɛ ha wɔ daa.

verses.label: Chorus
verses.text:
Daa, daa Yehowa hi,
E suɔmi ngɛ ha wɔ daa.

hymns.title: O Nine Nya Ni Tsum' Ngɛ Fɛu

verses.text:
O nine nya ni tsum' ngɛ fɛu,
E ngɛ nyakpɛ.

verses.label: Chorus
verses.text:
E ngɛ nyakpɛ
O nine nya ni tsum' ngɛ fɛu,
E ngɛ nyakpɛ.

hymns.title: Kɛ Mi Pee Nɔ Nɛ O Suɔ

verses.text:
Kɛ mi pee nɔ nɛ O suɔ,
I ji O muɔ ɔ he jalɔ,
O kɛ O muɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ he mi,
Nyɔmtsɛ lee kɛ mi pee nɔ nɛ O suɔ

Lɔ 'ɔ he ɔ, wa ma la Ebeneza
Nɛ wa ma de ke ɔ:
He nɛ Mawu kɛ wɔ ba su nɛ.

Aleluya.

hymns.title: Mwɔ Nɛ He Wa Ji Yehowa

verses.text:
Mwɔ nɛ he wa ji Yehowa,

O mi nɛ he tsɔli tsuo maa na he fami,
Mwɔ nɛ he wa ji Yehowa.

Ye bimɛ tsɔwi nyɛ ko ye gbeye:
Mawu ma hyɛ nyɛ nɔ.

Lɛ ji Nɔ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ nɔ hyɛe,
E ma bɔ mɔde ha nyɛ kaa
Nɔ ko be nyɛe ma pee nyɛ,

hymns.title: Mawu Lee Mo Nɛ Wa Ma Ja

verses.text:
Mawu lee Mo nɛ wa ma ja Mo
Mo nɛ O bɔ hiɔwe kɛ zugba,

hymns.title: E Ji Mawu Nɛ Tsake We

verses.text:
E ji Mawu, E ji Mawu,

Nɔ agbo nɛ O pee,

hymns.title: Mawu Hi, O Mawu Hi Daa

verses.text:
Mawu hi, o Mawu hi daa,

verses.text:

Ao ejakaa Tsaatsɛ Mo ji ye mɔbɔ nalɔ,
Nɛ O kɛ O dloomi ɔ he ye yi wam'
Tsaatsɛ Mawu lee, mɛnɔ I kɛ ma je O yi?
Ye Mawu lee, ma je O yi daa.

hymns.title: I Kɛ O Yi Jem' Ngɛ Mo Hae

verses.text:
I kɛ O yi jem' ngɛ Mo hae,
Ye Kpɔlɔ kpakpa, ye Kpɔlɔ kpakpa,
O kɛ mi yi ngɛ ye t-mi nya;
O hanɛ je na mi ekohu,
I kɛ O yi jem' ngɛ Mo hae,
Ye Kp-lɔ kpakpa, ye Kp-lɔ kpakpa.

hymns.title: Tulɔ Ji Mo, Tulɔ Ji Mo, Tulɔ Ji Mo

verses.text:
Tulɔ ji Mo, Tulɔ ji Mo, Tulɔ ji Mo,
Yesu, Mo ji wa Tulɔ;
I ka Mo nɛ I hyɛ nɛ I na hu kaa,
Yesu Mo ji wa Tulɔ.

hymns.title: He Wam' Tsuo Ngɛ Mawu Dɛm' B

verses.text:
Tumi Yɛ Wo Nyankopɔn Dea
He wami tsuo ngɛ Mawu dɛm'
He wam' tsuo pɛ, O nɔ;
Asafo Yehowa, blema tsɛmɛ hu a Mawu,
He wam' tsuo ji O nɔ,
He wam' tsuo ji O nɔ.

hymns.title: Munyu Tsuo Nɛ Ma I Tu Oo

verses.text:
Munyu tsuo nɛ I ma tu oo,
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ I ma pee,
E sa kaa ma bi ye he ke;
E ma sa Yesu hɛm' lo?

hymns.title: Yawɛ Lee, O He Ngɛ Nyakpɛ

verses.text:
Yawɛ lee, O he ngɛ nyakpɛ
Yawɛ lee, O he ngɛ gbeye;
Je ɔ tsuo pɛ a Mawu ji Mo,
Je ɔ tsuo pɛ ngɛ O dɛm'
Yawɛ lee, O he ngɛ nyakpɛ,
Yawɛ lee, O he ngɛ gbeye.

O hi, o Mawu hi;
Mawu, O hi, Mawu, O hi;
Mawu ji suɔmi, Mawu ji suɔmi,
Nɛ E si womi ji anɔkuale:
Ma je ye tsui mi kɛ na Lɛ si,
Nɛ ma la la ko ke Mawu, O hi;
Nyɔmtsɛ ji wa Nyɔmtsɛ,
E ni tsumi tsuo pɛ ngɛ fɛu,
E ji agbo, nɛ E he ngɛ nyakpɛ;
Ma kplasi ngɛ E sɛ ngua a hɛ mi.
Nyakpɛ suɔmi oo
Nyakpɛ suɔmi nɛ e se be po,
Nyakpɛ suɔmi nɛ e se be po,
Nyakpɛ suɔmi nɛ e se be po.
Kɛ ma pee kɛ ma suɔ Lɛ?

Tsaatsɛ ba nyɛ ye hɛm'
Kɛ mi ya su ye blɔ nya tam' he
Nɛ I kɛ he tsɔli ɔmɛ tsuo bua wa nya kɛ je O yi.
Ta ye dɛm' nɛ O kɛ mi po oslɔke
Ta ye dɛm' nɛ O kɛ mi po oslɔke.
Nyɛ ye hɛm',tsɔɔ mi blɔ kɛ ya su we
Ha O bɔfo ɔmɛ ba fia blɔm' tso ham'
Nyɛ ba fia blɔm' tso ham'
Nyɛ ba fia blɔm' tso ham'.
Nyɛ ba nyɛɛ ye hɛm' kɛ ya su hiɔwe wem'.

kaa a ma jɛm' ngɛ Yesu he;

ligbi nɛ a fɔ mi ɔ, I kɛ nɔ ko tsa bɛ
